title: You Set The Standard
text: [Music] look at the word king king first of all means ruler anybody grew up with uh those little plastic rulers in your bag when it's going to school or the wooden one remember the wooden one they call them rulers don't they take them to school they got rulers now they call that a ruler because a the word ruler means standard you notice a ruler does what it draws a straight line what does a line do as soon as you draw it two things one it separates if you got a blank page with no lines on it there's no separation the means you draw a line there's separation and secondly when you draw a line you set a standard that's a ruler means a ruler draws the line god draws the line he decides what's right or wrong what's up or down what's left or right he decides what's good or bad you don't decide that god is the ruler he draws the line that's why god gave moses a ruler when the people were sinning and messing up god gave moses a ruler he gave him ten marks on a ruler we call them the ten commandments these are the ruler that's the standard moses if they want to live right they must keep these standards that's what ruler is so king means to set the staff you
